name: ISRCTN_search_trials
description: Search the ISRCTN clinical trial registry by free text. The official XML API has no pagination and returns at most 100 matches; metadata explicitly reports truncation, unreachable_results, and whether increasing limit can retrieve more. No API key required.

doi.description: DOI of the registry record itself, e.g. '10.1186/ISRCTN12336055'.

eudract_number.description: The trial's EU CTR/EudraCT number, where it is also registered there. The same trial under two registrations is one trial, and counting both double-counts.

clinicaltrials_gov_number.description: Its NCT number, where it is also on ClinicalTrials.gov. Same caution.

scientific_title.description: Scientific title, usually naming the design and the comparator.

study_hypothesis.description: What the trial set out to test.

primary_study_design.description: e.g. 'Interventional' or 'Observational'. Decides what the result can support.

overall_end_date.description: When the whole study ends or ended.

name: ISRCTN_search_trials_fielded
description: Field-scoped ISRCTN search using its boolean query DSL. The official XML API has no pagination and returns at most 100 matches; metadata explicitly reports truncation, unreachable_results, and whether increasing limit can retrieve more.

q.description: Raw ISRCTN field-scoped boolean query, used verbatim. Examples: 'condition:diabetes', 'phase:"Phase III"', 'gender:Female AND condition:asthma'.

query.description: Alias for 'q'; a full field-scoped DSL string.

condition.description: Condition field helper (compiled to condition:VALUE), e.g. 'diabetes'.

phase.description: Phase field helper (compiled to phase:VALUE), e.g. 'Phase III'.

gender.description: Gender field helper (compiled to gender:VALUE), e.g. 'Female'.

country.description: Recruitment country field helper (compiled to recruitmentCountry:VALUE).

drug_name.description: Drug name field helper (compiled to drugName:VALUE).

doi.description: DOI of the registry record itself, e.g. '10.1186/ISRCTN12336055'.

eudract_number.description: The trial's EU CTR/EudraCT number, where it is also registered there. The same trial under two registrations is one trial, and counting both double-counts.

clinicaltrials_gov_number.description: Its NCT number, where it is also on ClinicalTrials.gov. Same caution.

scientific_title.description: Scientific title, usually naming the design and the comparator.

study_hypothesis.description: What the trial set out to test.

primary_study_design.description: e.g. 'Interventional' or 'Observational'. Decides what the result can support.

secondary_study_design.description: The design in more detail, e.g. 'Randomised parallel trial'. Whether randomisation happened is here, not in primary_study_design.

interventions.description: What was given, in detail. The description carries dated amendments, e.g. 'Current interventions as of 02/11/2026', so what the trial does now may differ from what it registered.

description.description: What it is, as registered, including amendment history.

items.description: One entry. This upstream returns such a list as scalars in some replies and as full records in others, so an element can be either.

primary_outcomes.description: The pre-specified primary outcomes. Changing a primary outcome after a trial starts is the classic form of outcome switching, so `measure` here is what the trial should be judged on.

timepoints.description: When. Two trials measuring the same outcome at different times are not directly comparable.

secondary_outcomes.description: Secondary outcomes, same shape. A positive secondary outcome in a trial whose primary outcome failed is not a positive trial.

inclusion.description: Inclusion criteria, as free text, including amendment history.

exclusion.description: Exclusion criteria. These decide how far the result generalises.

total_final_enrolment.description: How many actually enrolled. Far below target means the trial is underpowered against its own protocol, which no p-value in the paper will say.

overall_end_date.description: When the whole study ends or ended.

sponsors.description: Who is responsible for the trial.

commercial_status.description: Whether the sponsor is 'Commercial' or not. A commercial sponsor of a trial of its own product is a competing interest the registry states plainly.

sponsor_type.description: The sponsor's role, e.g. 'Lead'. Null where the registry did not record one.

funders.description: Who paid. A funder that also makes the product under test is a competing interest the registry states and the paper may not.

contacts.description: Who to contact, with their role.

ipd_sharing_statement.description: Whether individual participant data will be shared, e.g. 'No'. Decides whether the result can be re-analysed by anyone else.

name: ISRCTN_get_trial
description: Retrieve a single ISRCTN clinical trial by its ISRCTN id (e.g. 'ISRCTN12336055'). Returns the full record: title, scientific title, acronym, study hypothesis, plain-English summary, primary and secondary study design, phase, conditions, interventions, primary and secondary outcomes, inclusion/exclusion eligibility (gender, age range, healthy volunteers), sponsors, funders, contacts, recruitment countries, recruitment start/end dates, drug names, target and final enrolment, IPD-sharing statement, end date, and cross-reference ids (DOI, EudraCT, ClinicalTrials.gov). No API key required.
